id: \bWelcome to the Club Battle. Would you like to enter? This years prize is a set of Feathers.
en: \bWelcome to the Club Battle. Would you like to enter? This years prize is a set of Feathers.
it: \bBenvenuto al Club Battle. Vuoi partecipare? Il premio di quest'anno è un set di Piume.

id: \bThe rules are simple. All you have to do is get to the other side of the room while beating the Trainers. Grab the Feathers to win.
en: \bThe rules are simple. All you have to do is get to the other side of the room while beating the Trainers.  Grab the Feathers to win.
it: \bLe regole sono semplici. Devi solo raggiungere l'altro lato della sala battendo gli Allenatori. Prendi le Piume per vincere.

id: \bThe Club Battle is over. Come again next year.
en: \bThe Club Battle is over. Come again next year.
it: \bIl Club Battle è finito. Torna l'anno prossimo.
